Game Overview

Stickman Fall puts players into a arcade experience centered on guide your stickman through a treacherous shaft filled with obstacles. Use precision and quick reflexes to dodge dangers, collect stars, and reach the bottom safely. Unlock new skins and master the art of falling in this addictive, simple yet challenging arcade experience that keeps you coming back for more.
